### Field Visit to High Voltage Engineering Laboratory, National Engineering College, Kovilpatti on 24-10-2024

- November 7, 2024

A field visit was arranged on 24.10.2024 to National Engineering College, Kovilpatti for IV year students of Electrical and Electronics Engineering. 45 students along with faculty members Dr. M. Ramuvel, Associate Professor and Mr. R. Vinothkumar, Assistant Professor visited the campus. The field visit aimed to deepen the students’ understanding of high-voltage generation, testing, and measurement equipment, and to observe the advanced research activities in this specialized area. The objective of the visit was, to gain hands-on experience with high-voltage engineering equipment, understand safety protocols and practical challenges in high-voltage applications and observe the testing procedures of insulation and electrical components.

Upon the arrival at the High Voltage Engineering Laboratory, we were welcomed by Dr.M.Willjuice Iruthayarajan, Professor and Head of the Department, Dr. R. V. Maheswari, Professor and head of the laboratory, K. Kumar, Assistant Professor and Dr. P. Samuel Pakianathan, Assistant Professor. Mr. K. Kumar provided an overview of the laboratory’s setup, its purpose, and about the types of testing facilities available.

The students were given an orientation on the various equipments used, such as:

Impulse Generator: Used to create high-voltage pulses for testing insulation strength.

Transformers and Switchgear Testing Unit : Used to assess transformer insulation and switchgear performance under high voltage.

Partial Discharge Measurement System : This equipment measures the partial discharge in electrical insulations, an indicator of insulation integrity.

The laboratory is an active centre for research in Dielectric Materials, Insulation Systems, High Voltage and related phenomena. The laboratory also offers commercial testing and consultancy service. It has state-of-the-art facilities like 100kV AC, 140kV DC and 280kV Impulse Generation.

During the visit, the students observed the operation of the impulse generator and witnessed a demonstration of insulation testing on a transformer. The lab technicians demonstrated

- The process of creating impulse voltages.

- Techniques for measuring dielectric breakdown voltage.

- Methods of measuring partial discharge and corona formation in electrical equipment.

In the afternoon session, the team visited Liquid dielectrics laboratory. Dr. P. Samuel Pakianathan explained the testing procedure of liquid dielectrics. The laboratory is initially established under the Department of Science and Technology. The lab has the facility of Transformer oil testing kit, Viscosity meter, Flash and Fire point measurement.

OUTCOME OF THE VISIT:

- The field visit was highly educational and successful in achieving its objectives.

- The students gained valuable practical knowledge, and the visit helped to bridge the gap between the theoretical concepts and the practical applications.

page_title: BUSINESS BUZZ 2026 – ONE-DAY STUDENT INNOVATION STALLS On 06-10-2026
text:
### BUSINESS BUZZ 2026 – ONE-DAY STUDENT INNOVATION STALLS On 06-10-2026

- October 7, 2026

The Department of Mechanical Engineering and SAEINDIA Collegiate Club of AAA College of Engineering and Technology (AAACET), Amathur, successfully organized “Business Buzz 2026 – One-Day Technical & Multi-Faceted Student Innovation Stalls” on 06 October 2026 at the AAACET Oxford Block Stone Bench. The event provided students with a platform to showcase their entrepreneurial ideas, creativity, teamwork, and business management skills through various innovative stalls.

A total of 25 student stalls were established, covering a wide range of products and services including food and beverages, traditional sweets, jewellery, 3D printing, desserts, snacks, and other innovative student ventures. The stalls encouraged students to experience practical aspects of entrepreneurship such as product selection, pricing, marketing, customer interaction, sales, and financial management.

The programme was conducted with the active participation of student coordinators Mari Shankar S, Vairamani M, Muthu Vijaya Manikandan R, and Samvel M, under the guidance of the faculty coordinators Mr. A. Vignesh Moorthy Pandian, AP/MECH, and Mr. M. Nagendran, AP/MECH.

The Business Buzz 2026 initiative served as an effective platform for developing entrepreneurial thinking, innovation, communication, leadership, teamwork, and managerial skills among students. The event successfully transformed student ideas into practical business experiences and encouraged them to explore entrepreneurship as a potential career pathway.

page_title: FOOD SAFETY AWARENESS: EMPOWERING YOUTH FOR SDG GOALS on 03-03-2026
text:
### FOOD SAFETY AWARENESS: EMPOWERING YOUTH FOR SDG GOALS on 03-03-2026

- March 4, 2026

The NSS Unit of AAACET, in association with the Food Safety Department, Virudhunagar, organized a Food Safety Awareness Program on 03 March 2026 at the college premises. The program aimed to sensitize students to the growing concerns of food adulteration and to equip them with practical knowledge to identify adulterated food products. The session was conducted by Mr.B.Jothibasu, Food Safety Officer, Virudhunagar, delivering an insightful and interactive lecture. Various types of adulteration commonly found in food items such as milk, spices, oils, and grains were explained. Demonstrations showcased simple household techniques that can be used to detect adulteration. Students actively participated in the session, raising questions and sharing their observations, which made the program highly engaging. The resource person emphasized the importance of consumer awareness in ensuring food safety and highlighted the role of youth in spreading knowledge about safe consumption practices. The theme of the program was connected to Sustainable Development Goals 3 and 12, encouraging students to adopt responsible habits that contribute to a healthier society. The event concluded with a vote of thanks delivered by the Physical Director, Mr.M.Veerukkannan, appreciating the efforts of the Food Safety Department and the active involvement of students. The program was coordinated by Mr.S.Balamurugan, NSS Program Officer.

text:
### SCHOOL INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM (SIDP) BOOT CAMP on 06-02-2026

- February 10, 2026

The NSS Unit of AAACET, in collaboration with the Tamil Nadu School Education Department and UNICEF, successfully organized a two‐day School Innovation Development Program (SIDP) Boot Camp 2.0 from 5 to 6 February 2026 at the Kamarajar Auditorium. The camp aimed to nurture creativity, innovation, and problem‐solving skills among school students. The program was inaugurated by District Chief Education Officer Mr.K.Aravindhan, in the presence of Principal Dr.M.Sekar, EDIITN Joint Director Dr.Perpet, and UNICEF Yuwah Lead Mr.Vamsi Krishna. As part of this initiative, guide teachers were appointed to train students in creative thinking and innovation. Out of 778 projects submitted in Virudhunagar district, 29 teams were shortlisted to present their ideas at the boot camp. A total of 133 students, guided by 29 mentor teachers, actively participated in the camp. Faculty mentors including Dr. Dany, Dr. Rajaletchumi, Dr. Pradeep, Dr. Arivarsan, Dr. Jaganathan, and Dr. Pradeepa provided training and support throughout the sessions. The evaluation panel comprised Dr.Suresh Babu, Dr.Sivaranchani, Dr.Dany, Dr.Thenmozhi, Mr.Saravanan, and Mr.Sudharsan Anbazhagan, who assessed the projects, offered constructive feedback, and motivated the participants. The camp was effectively conducted under the leadership of District Project Manager Mr.P.Philip Milton and District Environmental Coordinator Mr.Ilayaraja, with strong organizational support from the NSS volunteers of AAACET, coordinated by NSS Program Officer Mr. Balamurugan.

Description about the Programme | The NSS Unit of AAACET organized a community outreach visit on 29-09-2024 to the CYBIO Orphanage in Vembakottai to support and bring joy to the children. Chief Guest Mr.K.Govindan, who independently runs and maintains the orphanage, graced the occasion, where volunteers formally appreciated his tireless social service and dedication. A dedicated team of 40 NSS volunteers systematically conducted a vibrant cultural program and various fun games designed to boost the confidence and happiness of the orphanage students. The interactive sessions allowed volunteers to engage closely with the children, fostering a deep sense of companionship and mutual respect. The visit strengthened community ties and equipped the NSS volunteers with practical insights into grassroots social care and humanitarian service. This program was coordinated by NSS Programme Officer Mr.S.Balamurugan.

page_title: A NATIONAL LEVEL TECHNICAL SYMPOSIUM – “TECH FUSION 2K25” on 17-10-2025
text:
### A NATIONAL LEVEL TECHNICAL SYMPOSIUM – “TECH FUSION 2K25” on 17-10-2025

- November 22, 2025

Organized by: Department of Computer Science and Engineering Institution: AAA College of Engineering and Technology, Amathur, Sivakasi Date: 17th October 2025 Venue: Kamarajar Auditorium, Oxford Block, AAA College of Engineering and Technology in Association with: Computer Society of India (CSI) Student Chapter

About the Event

The Department of Computer Science and Engineering of AAA College of Engineering and Technology successfully organized TECH FUSION 2K25 , a National Level Technical Symposium , on 17th October 2025 .

This grand event, conducted in association with the CSI Student Chapter , served as a platform for aspiring engineers to explore new technologies, share innovative ideas, and demonstrate their technical excellence.

The symposium aimed to bridge the world of computing by encouraging students to participate in both technical and non-technical events that fostered creativity, problem-solving, and collaboration.

Inaugural Session

The program commenced at 10.00 a.m. with the Tamilthai Vazhthu followed by the lighting of the lamp ceremony, symbolizing knowledge and enlightenment. Ms. G. Anupriya (III CSE) welcomed the gathering, followed by the Inaugural Address delivered by Dr. J. Hemalatha , Professor & Head (CSE – UG &PG), who highlighted the department’s consistent efforts in promoting research, innovation, and practical learning.

Dr. M. Sekar , Principal, in his Felicitation Address , appreciated the organizing team and encouraged students to actively engage in interdisciplinary learning to stay ahead in the dynamic field of computing.

Chief Guest Address

The Chief Guest of the event, Ms. V. Mirra , HR Manager – A&T Video Networks Pvt. Ltd. , was introduced by Ms. M. Vishnu Bala (IV CSE) .

In her inspiring address, Ms. Mirra emphasized three key aspects for every aspiring engineer:

- Passion: She spoke about the power of passion in shaping one’s career and life goals. She urged students to discover what truly excites them and to pursue it relentlessly, as passion is the driving force behind innovation and success.

- Surviving in the Competitive World:

Ms. Mirra discussed the importance of continuous learning, adaptability, and effective communication to survive and thrive in today’s rapidly changing technological landscape. She stressed that resilience, teamwork, and a growth mindset are essential to stand out in the professional world.

- AI and the Future of Work:

She shared valuable insights on how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming every industry and creating new opportunities. She encouraged students to upskill themselves in AI, data analytics, and automation technologies to stay relevant in the evolving job market.

Her motivational talk left the audience energized and inspired to approach their careers with confidence and curiosity. The Chief Guest was then honoured with a memento as a token of gratitude.

Technical Events

The event concluded with the National Anthem at 4.30 p.m.

TECH FUSION 2K25 was a resounding success, combining innovation, competition, and learning. The symposium not only showcased students’ technical potential but also emphasized the importance of passion, perseverance, and adaptability in the era of Artificial Intelligence.

The event truly reflected the Department of Computer Science and Engineering’s commitment to nurturing future-ready engineers and innovators.

With every initiative it undertakes, the CSE Department continues to ignite minds, transform ideas into impactful solutions, and pave the way for a smarter, tech-empowered tomorrow.

text:
### AAACET Campus Recruitment Training Programme WEBBERAX on 30-09-2025

- October 4, 2025

AAA College of Engineering and Technology is proud to announce that WEBBERAX will be conducting a campus recruitment drive for the 2026 graduating batch on 30th September 2025 . This exclusive opportunity is open to students from the CSE & ECE department , with a competitive salary package of 3.12 LPA . As part of the preparation, our Training and Placement Cell has arranged focused training sessions that include aptitude practice, technical workshops, and mock interviews to help students perform confidently during the drive. The training emphasizes core concepts , problem-solving techniques, and practical applications relevant to the industry. In addition, sessions on resume building, communication skills, and group discussions are being organized to enhance student readiness. Students are also encouraged to strengthen their knowledge in areas such as circuit analysis, power systems, control systems, and electrical machines , which are vital for technical interviews. The placement drive will follow a multi-round selection process including aptitude tests, technical assessments, and HR interviews . This is a valuable opportunity for students to start their careers with a reputed company and gain real-world exposure in their domain. We strongly encourage all eligible students to actively participate, prepare thoroughly, and make the best use of this placement opportunity.

The event was attended by AAACET’s leadership, including Dr. P. Karvannan (Chairman & Secretary), Dr. P. Ganesan (Correspondent), Dr. K. Vignesh Kumar (Joint Secretary), Dr. M. Sekar (Principal), Mr. J. Saravanalal (Placement Director), and Dr.G. Jayahari Prabhu (TPO). Their active participation underscored the importance of such initiatives in enhancing students’ professional readiness. Students will have not only improved their aptitude and reasoning skills but also gained valuable insights into the corporate world , helping them become more confident and job-ready for the future. This initiative highlights AAACET’s commitment to providing a holistic education that prepares students for success in both academic and professional areas.

### Higher Education Guidance Program for School Students on 05.01.2024

- January 6, 2024

As per the instructions given by the State NSS Officer, the NSS Unit of AAA College of Engineering & Technology organized the Higher Education Guidance Program on 05-01-2024 at KSG Government Higher Secondary School, Amathur. The NSS Program Officer and the NSS Volunteers attended the School Management Committee (SMC) meeting and interacted with the members. Along with the headmaster, SMC members, NSS volunteers, and staff members visited the school campus. NSS volunteers explained the features available on the Naan Mudhalvan website for school students. NSS volunteers interacted with school students and gave higher education guidance on various options available after higher secondary education. NSS volunteers insisted the school students utilize the Naan Mudhalvan portal for entrance exam notification and preparation. 115 students actively attended the program. This guidance program was coordinated by the NSS unit coordinator, Mr. S. Balamurugan, and the placement officer, Dr. V. Vivek.

### Mental Health and Emotional Well-being in Adolescence on 02-03-2026

- March 3, 2026

The Women Empowerment Cell of AAA College of Engineering and Technology successfully organized an Awareness Programme on Mental Health and Emotional Well-being in Adolescence on 02.03.2026 at 1:30 p.m. in the Kamarajar Auditorium, Oxford Block, under the guidance of the Chair Person, Dr. N. Thenmozhi, AP/ECE, and coordinated by Dr. P. Jessintha, AP/Eng, and Ms. R. Jaidhani, AP/IT, Convenors of the Cell. The session was delivered by Mrs. R. Devi, M.A., District Resource Person (TNCDW–TNSRLM), Collectorate, Virudhunagar, who provided insightful information on mental health awareness, emotional stability, stress management, and the importance of seeking timely support during adolescence. page_title: One Day National Level Technical Symposium – AMPHEROZ’24 on 06-03-2024
text:
### One Day National Level Technical Symposium – AMPHEROZ’24 on 06-03-2024

- March 14, 2024

The Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering organized a One Day National Level Technical Symposium ‘AMPHEROZ’24’ on 06.03.2024. S. Selva Priya III EEE welcomed the gathering. A. Priyanka II EEE introduced the resource person to the audience. Dr. M. Sekar, Principal, AAA College of Engineering and Technology delivered the presidential address. Dr. C. Senthil Kumar, Professor and Head, Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering delivered the inaugural address. The symposium events were inaugurated by the Chief Guest, Er. T. Muralidharan, AMIE, M.Tech., Executive Engineer, Distribution, TANGEDCO, Virudhunagar. The chief guest shared the overview of the roles and responsibilities of electricity boards in transmitting and distributing power from generation sources to end consumers. He also discussed the significance of renewable energy integration and energy storage solutions in optimizing grid operations and reducing conventional fossil fuels. The guest lecture provided a comprehensive overview of the challenges and opportunities in electricity board transmission and distribution to the students. Technical events such as paper presentation, project presentation, technical debate, circuit debugging, technical quiz and non-technical events like capture it, connection, and spotify were conducted by the students. The winners were awarded with a prize and a certificate. Totally 52 members from various Engineering and Polytechnic Colleges were actively participated in this event. R. Nithyalakshmi II EEE delivered the vote of thanks.

page_title: Report on Hands-On Training: AI-Enabled Cyber Security on 07-03-2026
text:
### Report on Hands-On Training: AI-Enabled Cyber Security on 07-03-2026

- March 9, 2026

The Department of CSE (Cyber Security) of AAA College of Engineering and Technology, in association with Cryptnova and the Institute of Engineers, organized a hands-on training on “AI-Enabled Cyber Security” for second year students on 7 th March 2026 in the Cyber Tech Centre Laboratory, Cambridge Block.

The programme began with a welcome address delivered by Ms. S. Sandeepa, III Year CSE (Cyber Security), who extended a cordial greeting to the dignitaries and participants. This was followed by the felicitation address by the Head of the Department, Dr. P. Elamparithi, who highlighted the growing significance of Artificial Intelligence in strengthening cyber security practices and encouraged students to gain expertise in this emerging domain.

The introduction of the resource person, Mr. E. Guru Chandran, Software Developer & Security DRI at Zoho Corporation Pvt. Ltd., was then presented by Ms. S. P. Deepika, III Year CSE (Cyber Security), outlining his professional experience and contributions to cyber security and AI.

The training session covered key topics such as footprinting and reconnaissance, enumeration, social engineering, Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks, and cryptography. The resource person also demonstrated the use of industry-relevant tools like Burp Suite to perform security testing and vulnerability analysis. Through hands-on activities and practical demonstrations, students gained valuable insights into identifying security threats, analyzing vulnerabilities, and applying AI-driven approaches to enhance cyber defense mechanisms.

The session effectively bridged the gap between theoretical knowledge and real-world applications, enhancing students’ technical competence, analytical thinking, and awareness of current cyber security practices.

The programme concluded with a vote of thanks delivered by Mr. V. Vijayakumar, III year CSE (Cyber Security), expressing sincere gratitude to the resource person, management, faculty members, and fellow students for their support and participation.

Overall, the hands-on training was informative and impactful, equipping students with essential knowledge and practical skills in AI-enabled cyber security.

page_title: Certificate Course on ‘Modern Techniques of Surveying’ from 01-02-2024
text:
### Certificate Course on ‘Modern Techniques of Surveying’ from 01-02-2024

- March 11, 2024

The Department of Civil Engineering organized a certificate course on ‘Modern Techniques of Surveying’ from 01/02/2024 to 05/02/2024 in the Surveying Laboratory. Dr. S. Krishnapriya, HoD/CE inaugurated the Certificate course and addressed the students about importance of Modern Techniques of surveying projects. Mr.K.Kaleeshwaran, Managing Partners, RVS Land Surveyors was the resource person for the course. This certificate course included hands on practices of Total Station, Differential Global Positioning System and Drone surveying. A Total Station course offers a thorough understanding of total station surveying instruments, covering electronic distance measurement (EDM) and theodolite functions. Participants acquire hands-on skills in precise angle and distance measurements, data collection, and spatial analysis, crucial for accurate mapping and construction projects.

A DGPS course provides a comprehensive overview of Differential Global Positioning System technology, emphasizing real-time corrections to enhance GPS accuracy. Participants gain practical insights into utilizing DGPS for precise navigation, mapping, and surveying applications across diverse fields, improving the efficiency and reliability of location-based data collection.

A Drone Surveying course provides comprehensive training on leveraging unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) for precise surveying applications. Participants learn drone flight operations, data acquisition techniques, and post-processing methods, enabling them to utilize aerial imagery effectively for mapping, terrain modeling, and survey analysis. Thirty Students from III Year and seven students from IV year B.E. Civil Engineering Department attended the course.

The “Modern Techniques of Surveying” five-day course offers a condensed yet comprehensive exploration of cutting-edge surveying methodologies. Participants delve into advanced technologies such as Total Stations, DGPS, and Drone Surveying, gaining practical insights into their integration for precise data collection, mapping, and spatial analysis in contemporary surveying applications. The course focuses on hands-on training, enabling participants to adeptly apply these modern techniques to enhance accuracy and efficiency in diverse surveying projects.

page_title: From Campus to Career: Pivotal Campus Recruitment Drive on 28-09-2026
text:
### From Campus to Career: Pivotal Campus Recruitment Drive on 28-09-2026

- September 29, 2026

AAA College of Engineering and Technology successfully conducted a Campus Recruitment Drive by Pivotal, Bangalore , on 28 September 2026 (Monday) for final-year students of the Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (AI&DS), Cyber Security, and Information Technology (IT) departments.

The recruitment drive provided students with a valuable opportunity to demonstrate their technical knowledge, skills, and professional abilities while exploring career opportunities with the organization. The selection process was conducted by Mr. Surendra and Ms. Aravindhu , who interacted with the students and assessed their suitability for the available positions.

The participating students demonstrated enthusiasm, confidence, and active involvement throughout the recruitment process. Three students successfully cleared the non-technical round , while the results of the technical round are awaited .

As a mark of appreciation for their achievement, Dr. M. Sekar, Principal, AAA College of Engineering and Technology , presented offer letters to the selected students and congratulated them on their performance.

The successful conduct of the recruitment drive was supported by the Management, Placement Director Mr. J. V. Saravana Lal, Placement Officer Dr. G. page_title: From Campus to Career: Lucas TVS Campus Recruitment Drive on 01-10-2026
text:
### From Campus to Career: Lucas TVS Campus Recruitment Drive on 01-10-2026

- October 3, 2026

AAA College of Engineering and Technology successfully conducted a Campus Recruitment Drive by Lucas TVS, Chennai , on 01 October 2026 (Thursday) for final-year students of the Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), and Mechanical Engineering departments.

The recruitment drive provided students with a valuable opportunity to explore career prospects and demonstrate their technical knowledge, skills, and professional abilities. The selection process was conducted by Mr. Daniel, HR , who interacted with the students and assessed their suitability for the available career opportunities.

The participating students demonstrated enthusiasm, confidence, and active involvement throughout the recruitment process. A total of 53 students were successfully selected , comprising 25 students from ECE, 12 students from EEE, and 16 students from Mechanical Engineering .

The successful conduct of the recruitment drive was supported by the Management, Placement Director Mr. J. V. Saravana Lal, Placement Officer Dr. G. Jayahari Prabhu, Placement Coordinators of the concerned departments, and Placement Team members , whose dedicated efforts contributed to the smooth coordination of the recruitment activities. page_title: From Classroom to Career: The Role of Professional Bodies on 19-08-2025
text:
### From Classroom to Career: The Role of Professional Bodies on 19-08-2025

- August 25, 2025

The Department of Science and Humanities organized a Motivational Talk for the First-Year Engineering Students (2025–2029 Batch). The program, titled “From Classroom to Career: The Role of Professional Bodies,” was held on August 19, 2025, at 1:15 p.m. in the Kamarajar Auditorium, Oxford Block. Mrs. G. A. Deva Priya, Assistant Professor of English, delivered the Welcome Address. Dr. K. Anand, Academic Coordinator, honored the Chief Guest, and Dr. S. Kiruthiga Deepa, Academic Coordinator, introduced the Chief Guest. The program was inaugurated by Dr. S. Arumuga Perumal, Director of Riyasaa Labs and Distinguished Professor of Computer Science and Research, Crown University International Chartered Inc., USA, who shared thought-provoking insights on technology and the importance of professional bodies. Students learned that professional bodies are organized associations that represent and regulate members of a specific profession. These bodies set standards for knowledge, ethics, and performance. Dr. Perumal highlighted two professional bodies—IEEE and IETE—which provide funding for seminars, workshops, and conferences, as well as publish research papers. The students participated enthusiastically and gained valuable knowledge about professional bodies and their role in career development. The program concluded with the Vote of Thanks delivered by Mr. P. Naveen Kumar, Assistant Professor of Chemistry.

page_title: Regenerate Earthworms to Ensure the Yield of Vermicomposting on 08-11-2024
text:
### Regenerate Earthworms to Ensure the Yield of Vermicomposting on 08-11-2024

- November 11, 2024

Eco and Nature Club of AAA College of Engineering and Technology (AAACET) Sivakasi, Organized “Regenerate Earthworms to Ensure the Yield of Vermicomposting” on 08.11.2024 to raise awareness about the crucial role earthworms play in the vermiculture process and its significant impact on waste management and soil health. The event featured a detailed presentation by Prof. Dr. J. Dharmaraja Head of the Department / S & H, explained the importance of vermicomposting and how regenerating earthworm populations can enhance the quality and quantity of vermicomposting. As a practical demonstration, 5 kg of earthworms were added to a vermiculture setup during the event to showcase the practical steps involved in regenerating earthworm populations for optimal composting results.

The event was targeted at students, environmental enthusiasts, and faculty members, aiming to educate them about the benefits of vermiculture and provide practical knowledge on managing earthworm populations to ensure effective composting. At the end of the programme each and every one took an oath to protect our environment as greener way.

page_title: AAACET Campus Recruitment Training Programme (ITC Infotech) on 17-09-2025
text:
### AAACET Campus Recruitment Training Programme (ITC Infotech) on 17-09-2025

- September 20, 2025

AAA College of Engineering and Technology is pleased to announce that ITC Infotech will be visiting our campus for a recruitment drive for the 2026 graduating batch . This placement opportunity is open to students from the CSE, ECE, and EEE departments, with an attractive salary package of 4 LPA . The drive is scheduled for 17th September 2025 . As part of the pre-placement preparation, our Training and Placement Cell has designed comprehensive training sessions to equip students with the necessary skills. These sessions cover aptitude and logical reasoning practice, technical knowledge enhancement, and intensive coding training to strengthen problem-solving abilities. Students will also undergo mock placement tests, group discussion practice, and soft skills development workshops to improve their confidence, communication, and teamwork skills. Additional focus will be given to resume building, interview handling techniques, and industry awareness sessions that highlight the latest IT trends and company-specific expectations. Through mock HR and technical interviews, students will receive personalized feedback to refine their performance. Special guidance will also be provided on academic project presentations, professional etiquette, and career growth opportunities in ITC Infotech . These structured training programs are aimed at ensuring our students are well-prepared, industry-ready, and confident to excel in the recruitment process and secure rewarding careers with ITC Infotech.

The event was attended by AAACET’s leadership, including Dr. P. Karvannan (Chairman & Secretary), Dr. P. Ganesan (Correspondent), Dr. K. Vignesh Kumar (Joint Secretary), Dr. M. Sekar (Principal), Mr. J. Saravanalal (Placement Director), and Dr.G.Jayahari Prabhu (TPO). Their active participation underscored the importance of such initiatives in enhancing students’ professional readiness. Students will have not only improved their aptitude and reasoning skills but also gained valuable insights into the corporate world , helping them become more confident and job-ready for the future. This initiative highlights AAACET’s commitment to providing a holistic education that prepares students for success in both academic and professional areas.

page_title: Global Trends in Science & Technology-“India’s Challenges and Opportunities”
text:
### Global Trends in Science & Technology-“India’s Challenges and Opportunities”

- March 2, 2018

Sivakasi, AAA College of Engineering &Technology organized a special Guest Lecture “ Global Trends in Science & Technology-India’s Challenges and Opportunities” on March 2, 2018 around 10 a.m. in the college A/C seminar hall. Prof.Dr.Vijendra Agarwal, Former Executive Fellow in the white house office of science and technology policy, USA was the guest of honor of the programme. Joint Secretary Er. K. Vignesh Kumar B.E., MBA (UK) headed over the programme. Dr.R.Jegannathan, Former Vice–Chancellor, Middle East University, UAE delivered the felicitation address.The chief guest in his speech insisted that Change is inevitable and constant. Only education could change the nation, especially women’s education and advised the students to be equipped with a thorough knowledge in their domain and upgrade themselves in recent technology. Students are the future and it’s their obligation to the society’s development in a collaborative nature and they should develop their entrepreneurial skills, he added. He insisted the students to get inspired with what they are learning, excel their technical competency skills and contribute to the society’s betterment. He encouraged the students to know the ‘don’t knows in science and technology’. He added that the younger generation need to possess 4Ts – Talent, Technology, Team Work, Think critically to solve problems and communicate effectively. He further appreciated the Indians’ cleverness in make-do technologies.

Amalraj, the proprietor of Joe Engineering, Chennai, the resource person of the seminar explained about various environmental issues that rose due to the improper waste disposal and about various entrepreneurship opportunities in the waste recycling field. page_title: The Department of IT organized the symposium ZANTRUM 2K26 on 13-03-2026
text:
### The Department of IT organized the symposium ZANTRUM 2K26 on 13-03-2026

- March 17, 2026

The Department of Information Technology successfully organized a symposium titled ZANTRUM 2K26 in association with TechNexus on March 13, 2026. The event was designed to create a vibrant platform for students to explore their talents, enhance their technical competencies, and gain exposure to both academic and real-world aspects of the IT industry. The symposium brought together students, faculty members, and industry professionals, making it a comprehensive learning and interactive experience. The atmosphere throughout the event was filled with enthusiasm, creativity, and a strong spirit of competition, reflecting the active involvement of participants.

The symposium was graced by the presence of two distinguished Chief Guests, Mr. S. J. Rajan, Senior Manager of Network and Infrastructure Security at Aravind Eye Care System, and Mr. T. S. Adithyan, Training DSP of Virudhunagar. Their presence significantly elevated the importance of the event.

During their address, they emphasized the growing demand for skilled professionals in the field of information technology and highlighted the importance of practical knowledge, cybersecurity awareness, and continuous learning. They shared valuable insights from their professional journeys, motivating students to stay dedicated, develop problem-solving abilities, and adapt to the ever- changing technological environment. Their speeches inspired students to think beyond textbooks and prepare themselves for real-world challenges.

ZANTRUM 2K26 featured a wide array of events that were carefully planned and executed by the student coordinators. These events were categorized into technical and non-technical segments, ensuring that students with diverse interests could actively participate and showcase their abilities. The technical events formed the core of the symposium, focusing on enhancing students’ subject knowledge and innovation skills. The paper presentation event encouraged participants to explore emerging technologies, conduct research, and present their ideas effectively. It helped students improve their analytical thinking, public speaking, and presentation skills. Many participants presented topics related to current trends such as artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and web technologies, which made the session highly informative.

The technical quiz was another engaging event that tested the participants’ knowledge of core IT concepts, recent technological advancements, and logical reasoning. It created a competitive yet enjoyable learning environment where students could assess their understanding and learn new facts. The UI/UX design event allowed participants to demonstrate their creativity and design thinking by creating user-friendly and visually appealing interfaces. It emphasized the importance of user experience in modern application development.

Similarly, the web design event provided a platform for students to showcase their technical expertise in developing responsive and attractive websites, highlighting their coding skills and creativity.

It served as a valuable experience that will contribute to their future career growth and personal development, leaving a lasting impression on everyone involved.

page_title: Design and Development of Electronic Circuits using Proteus on 25-09-2025
text:
### Design and Development of Electronic Circuits using Proteus on 25-09-2025

- September 29, 2025

The Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering organized a hands-on training programme on “Design and Development of Electronic Circuits Using Proteus Software” exclusively for II year students. The primary aim of this programme was to provide practical exposure to circuit simulation, thereby bridging the gap between classroom learning and real-time application. The event began with a formal inauguration, followed by a keynote introduction of the invited expert, Dr. N. Pothirasan , an eminent academician, researcher, and innovator in the field of Embedded Systems, IoT, and Power Electronics. He has a strong academic background, multiple funded research projects under DST, Government of India , and has published in reputed international journals. His achievements and contributions set a strong motivational tone for the students. During the session, the expert provided an in-depth overview of the Proteus simulation environment , demonstrating how to design, test, and troubleshoot electronic circuits virtually. Students were introduced to schematic diagram creation, component selection, and circuit execution processes with live examples.

The training emphasized the importance of simulation tools in reducing time, cost, and hardware-related errors before practical implementation. Dr. Pothirasan guided the students step by step, ensuring that even beginners could follow and perform the exercises effectively. The interactive approach encouraged active student participation, and many students clarified their doubts related to circuit design. Real-world applications and case studies of Proteus software were also highlighted, showcasing how industries and research labs rely on such tools for innovation and product development. Furthermore, the expert shared his own experiences in guiding over 200 student projects and developing industrial prototypes, inspiring the participants to take up innovative project ideas.

The session was not only technically enriching but also motivational, as it instilled confidence among students to handle complex simulations independently. By the end of the programme, students had gained hands-on experience in designing simple to moderately complex circuits and analyzing their performance in a virtual environment. The workshop created a strong foundation for their upcoming laboratory experiments, academic projects, and internships. Students expressed their appreciation for the clarity and depth with which the resource person explained the concepts. Faculty members also acknowledged the session as highly beneficial in improving the technical competency of students. Overall, the event was a grand success, fulfilling its objective of blending theoretical knowledge with practical application, while providing a platform for skill development in modern engineering practices. The department conveyed its gratitude to the management, faculty, and the expert speaker for their support in making the programme highly impactful.

page_title: Five Days Workshop on Robotics and Automation from 20-01-2026 to 24-01-2026
text:
### Five Days Workshop on Robotics and Automation from 20-01-2026 to 24-01-2026

- January 26, 2026

The Department of Information Technology of AAA College of Engineering & Technology organized a Five Days Workshop on “Robotics and Automation” during the academic year 2025–2026 from 20th January 2026 to 24th January 2026. The main objective of the programme was to provide students with in-depth knowledge of emerging technologies in intelligent systems, industrial automation, and real-time robotic applications, thereby bridging the gap between theoretical learning and industrial practices.

The workshop featured Mrs. K. Padmapriya, Assistant Professor, Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering, as the resource person. She conducted comprehensive sessions that combined conceptual explanations with practical demonstrations.

The programme was organized under the effective leadership of Mrs. S. Seethalakshmi, Head of the Department of Information Technology, and with the continuous encouragement and support of Dr. M. Sekar, Principal, AAA College of Engineering & Technology.

Throughout the five days, students were introduced to the fundamental principles of robotics and automation, including robotic components, sensors, actuators, controllers, and programming techniques.

The sessions highlighted how robotics and automation together enable the design and development of intelligent machines capable of performing complex tasks with minimal human intervention. Special attention was given to how these technologies enhance productivity, accuracy, operational safety, and cost efficiency in modern industries.

A dedicated segment of the workshop focused on the different types of robots and their real-world applications. Students learned about industrial robots, which play a crucial role in manufacturing units for assembly processes, welding operations, painting, and material handling.

The importance of service robots was also discussed, particularly their growing use in households and healthcare facilities for cleaning, cooking assistance, patient monitoring, and elderly care.

In addition to technical instruction, the resource person explained how robotics and automation are transforming major sectors such as manufacturing, healthcare, logistics, agriculture, and smart infrastructure. Case studies and industry examples were shared to demonstrate the deployment of robotic systems in surgical assistance, automated quality inspection, smart factories, and supply-chain optimization. Hands-on activities allowed students to work with basic robotic kits and simulation tools, enabling them to visualize

and implement concepts discussed during the sessions.

Interactive discussions, question-and-answer segments, and group activities created an engaging learning environment throughout the programme.

Students expressed great enthusiasm and curiosity, actively participating in demonstrations and brainstorming innovative ideas for future robotic applications. The workshop not only strengthened their technical foundation but also inspired them to consider research and career opportunities in the rapidly evolving fields of robotics and automation.

page_title: TECHFORGE 2K25 A National Level Technical Project Competition on 16-05-2025
text:
### TECHFORGE 2K25 A National Level Technical Project Competition on 16-05-2025

- May 19, 2025

On May 16, 2025, The Department of Mechanical Engineering of AAA College of Engineering and Technology (AAACET), in collaboration with the SAE India College Club, hosted TECHFORGE 2K25—a National Level Technical Project Competition. This event provided a platform for budding engineers to present innovative projects addressing real-world challenges.

The competition attracted 60 enthusiastic participants, including students from esteemed institutions such as K.L.N. College of Engineering and Technology, Hindustan College of Engineering, Saveetha Engineering College (Chennai), and Sankara Polytechnic College (Coimbatore). Additionally, students from various departments within AAACET actively participated, fostering interdisciplinary collaboration.

Dr. R. Selvabharathi, Head of the Department of Mechanical Engineering and the event’s convenor, inaugurated the event with a warm welcome address. The Chief Guest, Mr. B. Gopalakrishnan, M.Tech., Business Head of MS Fire & Safety Institution, Rajapalayam, was honored during the ceremony. In his keynote speech, Mr. Gopalakrishnan emphasized the significance of research, innovation, and intellectual property, encouraging students to transform their ideas into patents and practical solutions.

Participants showcased projects across diverse domains, including solar power, drones, agriculture, sustainable energy, additive manufacturing, IoT-based systems, hybrid vehicles, and electric vehicles. Each project was evaluated by a panel of experts based on criteria such as innovation, feasibility, technical depth, and societal relevant

The event was meticulously organized by faculty members Mr. A. Vignesh Moorthy Pandian (AP/MECH), Dr. P.S.R. Senthil Maharaj (ASP/MECH), and Mrs. V.S. Lakshmipriya (AP/MECH), ensuring its smooth execution. The competition concluded with the announcement of winners and the distribution of prizes to outstanding teams.

TECHFORGE 2K25 successfully achieved its objective of fostering creativity, technical acumen, and collaboration among engineering students. The event underscored AAACET’s commitment to nurturing talent, promoting research, and contributing meaningfully to the engineering community.

### Workshop on Prototype / process Design and Development-Prototyping – 13/04/2022

- April 19, 2022

The Institution Innovation Council (IIC) and Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) of AAA College of Engineering organized a “ One day Workshop on Prototype / process Design and Development-Prototyping” on 13.04.2022. The Programme was conducted at Thomas Alva Edison Hall. Ms.Swetha, Third Year, Department of ECE, Student Co-ordinator IIC, extended a warm greeting to the delightful gathering followed by Dr.G.Vairamuthu, President, IIC, who gave a brief about the workshop conducted at AAACET.

Er.C.Jai Kumar, Managing Director, CADD Academy, Madurai , was the resource person for this workshop. The Resource person listed out the features of 3D printing and scanning and its types and pointed out the benefits of 3D printing. Objectives of 3D Printing are to develop feedstock customized for 3D-printing at reduced cost, to increase knowledge on modelling & characterizations and develop specific tools, to define and establish standardization, regulatory issues, qualifications and risks analysis. Benefits of 3D Printing are rapid prototyping, most cost-effective manufacturing process, Flexibility, Better quality parts/product, Consistency, Risk reduction, easy accessibility. During the feedback session, the participants interacted with the resource person and clarified their queries regarding this policy. Nearly 90 students and 6 faculty members were participated in this workshop. Ms.P.Sakthipriya, Third Year, Department of ECE delivered the Vote of Thanks. Finally the Programme was ended with national anthem.

The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at AAA College of Engineering and Technology successfully organized its Association Inauguration Ceremony, in collaboration with the CSI Student Chapter, on August 6, 2025.

The event commenced with a formal welcome address by Mr. A. Vishnu Sekaran, followed by an inspiring presidential address from Dr. M. Sekar, Principal of AAACET, highlighting the department’s commitment to nurturing technical excellence and innovation.

Dr. J. Hemalatha, Head of the Department, announced the student executive committee members and unveiled the department’s academic and co-curricular roadmap for the year. The roadmap aims to empower students through a series of workshops, coding challenges, tech talks, and industry-focused engagements.

A key highlight of the event was the guest lecture on “Cloud Fundamentals with Azure” delivered by Mr. Arun Kumar, Team Leader at Accenture Services Pvt. Ltd. The session offered a comprehensive overview of cloud infrastructure, deployment models, service types (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), and emphasized real-world applications of Microsoft Azure in enterprise environments. page_title: Transforming Disaster Management and Resilience in Civil Engineering through Adaptive AI and Neuromorphic Computing from 10-02-2025 to 15-02-2025
text:
### Transforming Disaster Management and Resilience in Civil Engineering through Adaptive AI and Neuromorphic Computing from 10-02-2025 to 15-02-2025

- March 11, 2025

Organized by: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, AAA College of Engineering and Technology Date: 10th – 15th February 2025 Venue: Online

Total Participants: 140+ Total Sessions: 13

The AICTE Training and Learning (ATAL) Academy-sponsored Faculty Development Program (FDP) on Transforming Disaster Management and Resilience in Civil Engineering through Adaptive AI and Neuromorphic Computing was successfully conducted by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, AAA College of Engineering and Technology (AAACET) from 10th to 15th February 2025 . The FDP witnessed an overwhelming response, with more than 140 participants from across the country, including faculty members, researchers, and industry professionals. . The FDP aimed to explore cutting-edge AI technologies for disaster prediction, response, and resilience, with a special focus on neuromorphic computing and adaptive AI .

Inauguration and Objectives

The FDP commenced with an inaugural session , graced by chief patrons and dignitaries of AAACET . The event was coordinated by Dr. J. Hemalatha (Coordinator) and Dr. R. Raja Guru (Co-Coordinator) . The key objectives of the FDP were:

- Enhancing disaster forecasting accuracy using AI-driven predictive models.

- Leveraging real-time data from IoT, drones, and satellites for disaster response.

- Assessing infrastructure resilience against various disaster scenarios.

- Developing AI-based models for optimizing emergency response and recovery efforts.

Expert Sessions and Topics

The six-day FDP featured 13 expert-led sessions , delivered by renowned academicians and industry professionals from India and abroad . Some of the key sessions included:

- Disaster Management in Civil Engineering – Prof. Gang Li (Melbourne Burwood Campus, Australia)

- Neuromorphic Computing in Smart Infrastructure – Mr. E. Guru Chandran (Zoho Corporation)

- Advanced Predictive Models for Natural Disasters – Prof. Lorna Uden (Staffordshire University, UK)

- Intelligent Decision-Making Frameworks – Mr. Deva Bala (Corent Technology Inc, Chennai)

- Ethical, Legal, and Policy Implications in AI for Disaster Management – Dr. S. Venkataprasad (TCS, Chennai)

- Case Studies and Real-World Applications of AI in Disaster Resilience – Prof. Akhtam Kalam (Victoria University, Melbourne) and Dr. Surendar M (NIT Puducherry)

The comprehensive schedule covered theoretical foundations, real-world applications, and emerging challenges in disaster management through AI-driven solutions.

Outcome and Conclusion

The FDP provided in-depth knowledge and practical insights into the application of AI and neuromorphic computing for disaster preparedness, response, and resilience . The program also emphasized the importance of adaptive AI in infrastructure planning, risk assessment, and real-time decision-making .

text:
### oracle cloud infrastructure certification course from 19-08-2025 to 23-08-2025

- August 28, 2025

The Department of Information Technology, through its association TechNexus, successfully organized a five-day Internationally Recognized Certification Course on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) from 19th August to 23rd August 2025.

The training, powered by Oracle Tech Academy, was conducted at the Innovation Laboratory, Third Floor, Cambridge Block.

With the blessings of Shri. P. Panjurajan, Founder of AAA Group of Institutions, and under the esteemed guidance of Dr. P. Karvannan, Chairman & Secretary, Dr. M. Sekar, Principal, Dr. P. Ganesan, Correspondent, Dr. K. Vignesh Kumar, Joint Secretary, and Mrs. S. Seethalaksmi, AP & Head of IT Department, the program began with great enthusiasm. The course was effectively coordinated by Mr. N. Muniselvam, AP/IT.

The aim of this program was to impart knowledge to students on how cloud technology functions, what prerequisites are needed to work in the cloud environment, and how multi-cloud architecture can be designed and implemented. It was structured to provide both theoretical foundations and practical experience so that students could not only learn but also confidently work in a cloud-based environment

Throughout the 40 hours of training spread across five days, students gained a strong understanding of concepts such as cloud computing fundamentals, service and deployment models, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure basics, identity and access management, compute services, networking, storage solutions, and database services including autonomous databases. Each session was highly interactive and engaging, with experts making the learning process enjoyable by simplifying complex concepts and often entertaining the students during discussions to keep the environment lively.

One of the major advantages of this program was that it offered global-level certification from Oracle, which will add tremendous value to the students’ academic and professional journey.It gave them hands-on training with real-time scenarios, exposure to industry- standard practices, improved problem-solving skills, and confidence to handle cloud environments.Another key advantage was the opportunity to learn about multi-cloud architecture, which is highly sought after in the IT industry today. The experts appreciated the students for their discipline, dedication, and active participation, which made the sessions more vibrant and productive.

The five-day course proved to be a useful, memorable, and career-enriching experience for the students. It not only enhanced their technical abilities but also bridged the gap between academic learning and industrial practices.

By the end of the training, students walked away with valuable knowledge, a prestigious certification, and unforgettable learning moments that will guide their future endeavors in the IT sector.

This course aimed to equip our students with essential skills in computer-aided design (CAD) using Autodesk Fusion 360, leading software in the field. The training was conducted from January 22, 2024, to January 30, 2024, followed by the International Certification exam scheduled for February 2024. It was compulsory for all 3rd-year Mechanical Engineering students to participate in this course. The inauguration ceremony for the Autodesk Fusion 360 International Certification course took place on January 22, 2024, at 10:00 AM in the Thomas Alva Edison Seminar Hall, located in the Cambridge Block. This event marked the official commencement of the course and included addresses by Principal Dr.M.Sekar, Dr. M. Selvabarathi, Hod/Mech and Mr. P.S.R. Senthil Maharaj, Course coordinator and faculty members highlighting the importance and objectives of the training program.

The core training sessions for students were conducted from January 22, 2024, to January 30, 2024, in the CAD Lab. The training sessions covered various aspects of Autodesk Fusion 360, including but not limited to:

- Introduction to CAD and Fusion 360 interface

- Sketching and modeling techniques

- Parametric modeling

- Assembly design

- Simulation and analysis

- Documentation and collaboration tools

The training sessions were interactive, hands-on, and conducted by certified trainers with extensive experience in using Fusion 360 for real-world applications. Students had access to state-of-the-art facilities in the CAD Lab to practice and apply their learning effectively. The Autodesk Fusion 360 International Certification course was a significant initiative by the Department of Mechanical Engineering at AAACET to empower our students with practical skills and industry-relevant knowledge in CAD technology. We are confident that this course has contributed to the professional development of our students and prepared them to excel in their future careers. We appreciate the active participation of all 3rd-year Mechanical Engineering students in making this course a success.

### Interactive Session on From Campus to Creative: A Conversation on Industry Design

Department of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science organised an insightful interactive session titled “From Campus to Creative: A Conversation on Industry Design,” featuring Mr. N. R. Suresh Babu, the Designing Director of Zoho, Tenkasi. Drawing over 25 years of expertise in UI/UX, Mr. Suresh Babu emphasized that future career success depends heavily on practical, hands-on skills and real-world problem-solving rather than academic qualifications alone. He highlighted the expanding scope of the design field, noting that as digital applications proliferate, the demand for intuitive and visually appealing interfaces will continue to rise. Addressing concerns about automation, he clarified that while Artificial Intelligence will serve as a powerful assisting tool to speed up tasks, it cannot replace human designers because it lacks the core elements of empathy, emotional intelligence, and original creativity. The session concluded with an encouraging note on professional development and the announcement of current internship opportunities in the UI/UX domain at Zoho, reinforcing the importance of continuous skill acquisition in an evolving technological landscape.

text:
### From Code to Care: CSE Department Strengthens Parent–Teacher Synergy on 27-09-2025

- October 6, 2025

The Department of Computer Science and Engineering, AAA College of Engineering and Technology, organized a Parents–Teachers Meeting on 27th September 2025 (Saturday) from 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. at the Sir Visvesvaraya Seminar Hall, Cambridge Block.

The event was conducted with the blessings of Shri P. Panjurajan, Founder of AAA Group of Educational Institutions, and organized under the guidance of Dr. J. Hemalatha, Head of the Department (CSE), and Dr. P. Senthil Pandian, Academic Coordinator (CSE). The program was coordinated by Mrs. S. Lalitha Tharani and Mrs. T. Sowmya, Assistant Professors, Department of CSE.

The meeting provided a constructive platform for faculty members to interact with parents and discuss various aspects of students’ performance. The discussion primarily focused on academic progress, regular attendance, discipline, and participation in technical activities. Faculty members shared insights about the department’s initiatives, such as coding practice sessions, technical symposiums, workshops, and industry-oriented training programs designed to enhance students’ practical knowledge and employability skills.

Parents were briefed on the importance of continuous learning, project-based education, and hands-on exposure to emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Cyber security. They were also encouraged to motivate their wards to participate actively in coding contests, internships, and paper presentations organized by the department.

Additionally, faculty members discussed the placement training roadmap, academic support for slow learners, and the mentoring system adopted to monitor the overall development of each student. Parents expressed their appreciation for the department’s efforts in maintaining academic excellence, promoting innovation, and ensuring career readiness among students.

The session concluded with positive feedback from parents, who commended the department’s commitment to student development, discipline, and continuous improvement.

page_title: REPORT ON INDUSTRIAL VISIT TO KUDANKULAM NUCLEAR POWER PROJECT (KKNPP) on 23-10-2025
text:
### REPORT ON INDUSTRIAL VISIT TO KUDANKULAM NUCLEAR POWER PROJECT (KKNPP) on 23-10-2025

- October 29, 2025

The Department of Mechanical Engineering of AAA College of Engineering and Technology organized an Industrial Visit to the Kudankulam Nuclear Power Project (KKNPP), Tirunelveli District, on 23rd October 2025 for the III Year Mechanical Engineering students (Batch 2023–2027). The visit aimed to provide students with practical exposure to the functioning, operation, and safety systems of one of India’s largest nuclear power plants. The visit was coordinated and accompanied by Mr. A. Vignesh Moorthy Pandian, Mr. M. Balamurugan and Mr.M.Nagendran , Assistant Professor / Mech. The students departed from the college at 4:00 a.m. and reached Kudankulam by 9:00 a.m. After security clearance and registration, the team entered the plant premises at 9:30 a.m. The session commenced with an orientation about the overview of nuclear power generation, types of reactors, and pressurized water reactor technology used at KKNPP. Students were taken to key sections of the plant, including the Turbine Hall, Reactor Control Room (overview section), and Reactor Safety Display Units, where engineers explained the working principles of turbines, heat exchangers, and safety interlocks. The participants also learned about the coolant circulation system, containment structure, and emergency shutdown mechanisms. In the afternoon session, KKNPP engineers interacted with students and discussed nuclear safety protocols, radiation protection measures, and career opportunities in nuclear energy. The visit concluded with a group photo session and vote of thanks by the accompanying faculty members. The industrial visit provided valuable insights into advanced power generation technologies and real-time plant operations, bridging the gap between classroom learning and industrial practice. It enhanced students’ understanding of Power Plant Engineering, Design of Machine Elements, and Industrial Safety, motivating them toward careers in the energy sector.

page_title: WORKSHOP ON FOUNDATION OF AI AND EMERGING TECHNOLOGIES from 19-6-2026 to 24-6-2026
text:
### WORKSHOP ON FOUNDATION OF AI AND EMERGING TECHNOLOGIES from 19-6-2026 to 24-6-2026

- June 26, 2026

Department of Information Technology WORKSHOP ON FOUNDATION OF AI AND EMERGING TECHNOLOGIES SECOND YEAR STUDENTS

Executive Summary

This comprehensive document serves as the official technical report for the advanced AI and Data Science Training Workshop . The intensive program successfully bridged foundational theory and deployment across 11 core technological domains. Participants transitioned systematically from entry-level data manipulation to building modern generative models.

SECTION 1: DATA ANALYTICS FOUNDATIONS

TOPIC 1: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) OVERVIEW

- Definition : Core concepts of Narrow vs. General AI.

- Landscape : Historical evolution, modern industry paradigms, and future ethics.

- Ecosystem : Mapping data engineering, data science, and deep learning.

TOPIC 2: PYTHON LANGUAGE INTRODUCTION

- Syntax : Basic structure, variable declarations, and dynamic typing.

- Control : Conditional logic statements and iterable programmatic loops.

- Structures : Memory-efficient usage of lists, dictionaries, tuples, and sets.

- Functions : Definition structures, argument parsing, and modular lambda functions.

TOPIC 3: PANDAS DATA MANIPULATION (HANDS-ON)

- Objects : Structured data querying using Series and DataFrames.

- Ingestion : Loading structured datasets from CSV, Excel, and JSON.

- Cleaning : Handling missing matrix data, deduplication, and type casting.

page_title: “A Hands-on Journey into Electric Vehicle Mastery” from 22-01-2025 to 24-01-2025
text:
### “A Hands-on Journey into Electric Vehicle Mastery” from 22-01-2025 to 24-01-2025

- January 31, 2025

The Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering successfully organized a three-day Faculty Development Programme (FDP) titled “A Hands-on Journey into Electric Vehicle Mastery” from January 22 to January 24, 2025 . The programme provided an in-depth exploration of the latest advancements in Electric Vehicle (EV) technology, equipping faculty members with valuable insights and practical experience. The programme focused on crucial aspects such as the importance of electric vehicles, solar-based EV systems, multi-source EV solutions, recent trends in electric mobility, and the design and simulation of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSM).

The technical sessions are handled by the eminent academician and industrialist, who emphasized the need for sustainable mobility solutions and the role of academic institutions in fostering EV research and innovation. Over the three days, faculty members engaged in technical discussions, interactive workshops, and real-time simulations, enhancing their understanding of emerging EV technologies. The event successfully concluded with a valedictory session, where certificates were distributed to the participants. The Faculty Development Programme proved to be a significant step towards strengthening the knowledge base of educators in the field of electric vehicles, ultimately contributing to academic excellence and industry readiness.

page_title: Certificate Course on “Machine to Machine Communication using TI Embedded Controllers” on 07.03.2022
text:
### Certificate Course on “Machine to Machine Communication using TI Embedded Controllers” on 07.03.2022

- March 17, 2022

Texas Instruments Innovation Laboratory (TIIL) organized 3 days Certificate Course on “Machine to Machine Communication using TI Embedded Controllers” for final year EEE and ECE students from 07/03/2022 to 09/03/2022. The prime focus of this certificate course was to introduce Embedded Evaluation boards by Texas Instruments (TI) for Machine to Machine Communication. Totally 31 students participated and got hands on experience in all the embedded board available in TIIL.

In Day 1 (07/03/2022), participants gained basics knowledge about the embedded systems using TI embedded boards. Specifically they had hands on experience in MSP430G2ET, MSP430F5529 and MSP432P401R LaunchPads. TI Innovation Lab coordinator, Dr. S. Saravanan, AP/EEE briefed about the objectives of this centre. Also, he showcased the hardware peripherals available in Texas Instruments Innovation Laboratory. Coordinator of Centre for IIoT, Mr. M. S. Kalyanasundaram, AP/EEE trained the participants to access the I/O ports in various LaunchPads. Mr. P. Mohanraj, AP/ECE and Mr. G. Jayahari Prabhu, AP/ECE are trained the participants to interface various sensors and actuators with LaunchPads.

In Day 2 (08/03/2022), Mrs. M. Maheswari, AP/EEE introduced the concept of Machine to Machine Communication. The training on RF communication between two machines using 1GHz TI RF booster was given. The concept of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) was clarified. The participants learned to control one machine’s actuators through another machine without human interference.

In Day 3 (09/03/2022), the participants were trained in TI Robotic Systems Learning Kit (RSLK). The TI-RSLK installed with QTR sensor for detecting lines, bump switch for detecting obstacles and motors for rover movement. The participants solved the assignments in line-following robot, Obstacle avoidance robot and swarm robot.

The event, which began with a welcome address by Ms. V. Kiruthika and a feasibility address delivered by HoD Dr. P. Deva Balan, featuring a Chief Guest Mr. R. S. Saravanan, an expert in AI-driven government projects. Mr. Saravanan delivered a comprehensive presentation, first detailing Medical Artificial Intelligence and its role in revolutionizing diagnostics, treatment planning, and hospital automation through machine learning for early disease detection and precision medicine. He then emphasized the crucial need for Cybersecurity in the Medical Field, explaining how AI-based threat detection systems safeguard sensitive patient data from breaches, citing government initiatives for secure healthcare infrastructures. He also covered the evolution of medical hardware into AI-integrated smart devices like robotic surgery assistants and wearable monitors. Furthermore, he discussed the AI Revolution’s Economic Impact, highlighting the new employment opportunities and industrial progress driven by interdisciplinary learning, and demonstrated the use of AI in Robotics and Medical Applications for high-precision surgeries and rehabilitation. The event concluded with a Vote of Thanks, inspiring attendees to explore the vast opportunities in AI, medicine, and cybersecurity.

page_title: Hands-on Training Program on Car AC & Wheel Balancer On 02-02-2026 , 28-02-2026 & 02-03-2026
text:
### Hands-on Training Program on Car AC & Wheel Balancer On 02-02-2026 , 28-02-2026 & 02-03-2026

- March 4, 2026

The Department of Mechanical Engineering, AAA College of Engineering and Technology, Sivakasi, in association with the SAE INDIA Collegiate Club, organized a three-day Hands-on Training Program on Car AC & Wheel Balancer for Mechanical Engineering students from 27.02.2026 , 28.02.2026 & 02.03.2026 at Thomas Alva Edison Hall, AAA College of Engineering and Technology. The objective of the program was to provide students with practical exposure and technical knowledge in automobile air conditioning systems and wheel balancing techniques, which are essential in modern automobile servicing and maintenance. On Day 1 (27.02.2026), the session was handled by Mr. A. Vignesh Moorthy Pandian, Faculty In-charge – Centre of Excellence CAR and Assistant Professor, Department of Mechanical Engineering. During the session, he explained the fundamentals of Automobile Air Conditioning systems, including the working principles, major components, and operational mechanisms of Car AC systems. Students were introduced to the basic structure and functioning of automotive air conditioning systems used in modern vehicles. On Day 2 (28.02.2026), the session was conducted by Mr. M. Nagendran, Assistant Professor, Department of Mechanical Engineering. The session focused on Wheel Balancer technology. He explained the importance of wheel balancing in automobiles, the types of wheel imbalance such as static imbalance and dynamic imbalance, and their effects on vehicle stability, tyre wear, steering control, and overall vehicle performance. Students also gained insights into the working principle and operation of wheel balancing equipment used in automobile service centers. page_title: GUEST LECTURE ON OPTIMIZATION OF SOLAR POWER HARVESTING WITH DC – DC CONVERTERS ON 11-11-2024
text:
### GUEST LECTURE ON OPTIMIZATION OF SOLAR POWER HARVESTING WITH DC – DC CONVERTERS ON 11-11-2024

- November 13, 2024

The Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering organized a guest lecture on Optimization of Solar Power Harvesting with DC – DC Converters on 11-11-2024 (Monday) at Thomas Alwa Edison, Seminar hall, AAACET. The students of III and IV year Electrical and Electronics Engineering participated in the programme. K. Gayathri of III year EEE welcomed the gathering and R. Nithyalakshmi of III year EEE introduced the resource person to the audience. Dr. C. Senthil Kumar Professor and Head, Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering honored the resource person with a memento.

Dr. P. Maruthupandi., Associate Professor, Government College of Technology, Coimbatore is the resource person of the programme. During the lecture, he provided valuable insights in the following areas:

- Solar Power Harvesting Challenges: Discussing factors such as varying sunlight intensity, shading effects, and efficiency losses in photovoltaic systems.

- Role of DC-DC Converters: Explaining how these converters play a critical role in optimizing power extraction by maintaining the maximum power point (MPPT) of the solar panels Types of DC-DC Converters like Covering buck, boost, and buck-boost converters, along with their design considerations and applications in the solar power systems.

- Optimization Techniques: Highlighting advanced algorithms and control strategies, including perturb and observe (P&O), incremental conductance, and artificial intelligence methods for enhancing efficiency.

- Future Trends: Addressing the integration of hybrid energy systems and smart grid technologies for sustainable energy solutions.

His engaging presentation was complemented by practical examples, case studies, and simulations and he made the session highly informative for both students and faculty members. The lecture concluded with an interactive Q&A session where the participants actively sought clarification on the topics such as system efficiency, converter design, and real-world implementation challenges.

The guest lecture proved to be a highly enriching experience for the attendees, which broadened their knowledge of solar power optimization and advanced power electronics. The event concluded with a vote of thanks delivered by A. Priyanka of III year EEE.

page_title: Guest Lecture on Sustainable and Environmentally Friendly HV Insulation System on 18-09-2026
text:
### Guest Lecture on Sustainable and Environmentally Friendly HV Insulation System on 18-09-2026

- September 19, 2026

The Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering of AAA College of Engineering and Technology, organized a Guest Lecture on “Sustainable and Environmentally Friendly HV Insulation System” on 18.09.2026 (Friday) at Cambridge Block, First Floor.

The session began with a warm welcome, presided over by Dr. C. Senthil Kumar, Professor & Head / EEE. The resource person of the day was Mr. K. Kumar, M.E., (Ph.D.), Assistant Professor (Senior Grade), National Engineering College, Kovilpatti, who shared his valuable expertise in the field of High Voltage Engineering and insulation systems.

During the lecture, Mr. K. Kumar highlighted the importance of High Voltage (HV) insulation systems in modern electrical power transmission and distribution networks. He explained the need for sustainable and environmentally friendly insulation technologies and discussed recent developments in insulation materials and systems. He also emphasized the importance of developing insulation solutions that ensure reliable electrical performance while minimizing environmental impact. The session provided valuable insights into emerging technologies, current research trends, and future prospects in sustainable HV insulation systems.

The students actively participated in the interaction session, where they raised questions related to HV insulation materials, sustainable insulation technologies, insulation performance, and future research opportunities. The lecture enriched the participants with knowledge of recent advancements in High Voltage Engineering and motivated them to explore innovative and environmentally sustainable solutions in the field of Electrical Engineering.

Senthil Kumar Professor and Head, Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering honoured the resource person with a memento and a gift.

The resource person of the guest lecture was Mr. A. Saravana Kumar, M.E., (PhD) Scientist E/Joint Director, Power Electronics Group, CDAC, Thiruvananthapuram. The guest lecture was aimed to bring out a clear cut idea about the micro grid and its significance in modern energy systems and the challenges faced by remote villages in accessing reliable electricity. He shared the case studies and the successful examples of micro grid implementations in remote areas. The lecture also addressed the challenges faced in implementing micro grids in remote villages. This programme served as an eye opening session for the students. At the end of the session, he cleared the queries of the students and received feedback from the students. S. Selva Priya of III year EEE delivered the vote of thanks. Totally 63 students and 8 faculties attended the programme.

page_title: AAACET Inaugurates INFOZIANT Smart Skills: Aptitude & Reasoning Bootcamp on 04-08-2025 – 14-08-2025
text:
### AAACET Inaugurates INFOZIANT Smart Skills: Aptitude & Reasoning Bootcamp on 04-08-2025 – 14-08-2025

- September 11, 2025

The Infoziant Inauguration Ceremony at AAA College of Engineering and Technology (AAACET) was successfully held on 30.01.2025 at the Smart Skills: Aptitude & Reasoning Bootcamp on 4th August 2025 , running until 14th August 2025 . This 10-day intensive training program is designed to equip students with critical skills essential for campus placements and competitive exams. Focused on aptitude , logical reasoning , and effective communication , the program aims to sharpen problem-solving abilities, improve time management, and boost verbal and non-verbal communication skills. Through a combination of interactive workshops, real-time mock tests, and personalized feedback, students are exposed to practical training that mirrors the actual recruitment process. Expert trainers Mr. Ujjwal (Aptitude) and Ms. Gayathri (Communication) provide hands-on experience with complex reasoning exercises, quantitative aptitude, data interpretation, and verbal reasoning. Special emphasis is placed on improving critical thinking , decision-making , and teamwork skills , which are vital for both placement interviews and competitive exams.

The bootcamp includes daily assessments and quizzes to track progress and ensure that participants are continuously improving.
