- September 12, 2025

The Department of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at AAA College of Engineering and Technology, Sivakasi, through its TENSAI student technical association, successfully organized a seminar on “Action-Centric Intelligence: Designing Agentic AI that Thinks, Executes, and Adapts” on September 11, 2025, from 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM at Sir C.V. Raman Hall, Cambridge Block. The event witnessed participation from 109 students and faculty members and featured Dr. S. Thayammal, Ph.D. (B.S. – IITM), Director of Deep Dive Technologies, as the distinguished chief guest and keynote speaker. Dr. Thayammal brought extensive expertise in advanced AI, machine learning, and intelligent systems, commencing the session with a comprehensive introduction to Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning, tracing the evolution from traditional rule-based systems to adaptive and autonomous models. She elaborated on Agentic AI as a transformative class of intelligent systems capable of independently setting goals, planning multi-step strategies, executing complex tasks autonomously, and adapting dynamically with minimal human supervision. The speaker emphasized fundamental design principles including contextual reasoning, autonomous action, adaptive learning, and multi-agent orchestration, enabling AI systems to achieve intelligent, goal-driven operations across diverse domains. The presentation showcased real-world applications spanning finance, healthcare, IT services, cybersecurity, logistics, and research and development, demonstrating the versatility of agentic AI technologies. Participants were introduced to innovative implementations such as Comet, an AI-native browser exemplifying productivity-focused agentic AI through automated summarization and task management, alongside Physical AI applications in robotics, autonomous vehicles, and drones. Dr. Thayammal concluded by outlining future trajectories emphasizing multi-agent collaboration, strategic planning, real-time adaptation, workflow integration, robust feedback mechanisms, and ethical design principles for responsible AI deployment. The seminar successfully inspired participants to perceive artificial intelligence as a transformative force driving innovation, operational efficiency, and adaptive intelligence across all sectors, exemplifying the department’s commitment to bridging theoretical foundations with practical applications and preparing students for the evolving AI landscape.

text:
### FIVE DAYS CERTIFICATE COURSE ON ‘CIRCUIT DESIGN AND FABRICATION OF PCB’ From 12-08-2024 to 17-08-2024

- September 2, 2024

The department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering organized a five days certificate course on ‘CIRCUIT DESIGN AND FABRICATION OF PCB’ from 12.08.2024 to 17.08.2024. The students of III year Electrical and Electronics Engineering participated in this programme. V. G Padmpriya of III year EEE welcomed the gathering and R. Nithyalakshmi of III year EEE introduced the resource persons to the audience.

The resource person of the programme was Dr. N. Pothirasan, M.Tech., Ph.D., Director and Mr. M. Karthick M.E., Software Developer, Hashan Medicare, Rajapalayam. Dr. C. Senthil Kumar, Professor and Head of the Department delivered the presidential address to the participants and briefed the fundamentals of PCB design.

In day 1, Dr. N. Pothirasan introduced the Circuit Design and PCB Basics, overview of electronic components and circuit design, understanding the basics of PCBs and their importance in electronics. He explained the schematic capture and layout design of PCB using proteus software.

In day 2, Mr. M. Karthick created circuit schematics using PCB design software, simulation of circuit designs to ensure functionality and troubleshooting and optimizing circuit designs.

In day 3, Dr. N. Pothirasan covered the schematics into PCB layouts. He explained the design rules of PCB layout (trace width, spacing, etc.) and Techniques for efficient component placement and routing.

In day 4, Dr. N. Pothirasan covered the overview of PCB fabrication techniques (e.g., etching, milling) and hands-on experience with PCB fabrication tools and equipment.

In day 5, Mr. M. Karthick introduced the advanced PCB design concepts (e.g., multilayer boards, surface-mount technology.

Mr. M. Karthick also covered testing, troubleshooting techniques and debugging of the fabricated PCBs. This programme served as an eye opening session for the students. At the end of the session, the resource persons cleared the queries. Participants provided positive feedback on the course content, structure, and practical sessions. Many highlighted the hands-on experience as the most valuable aspect of the course. Several participants expressed their interest in pursuing further advanced courses in PCB design and fabrication. Dr. C. Senthil Kumar, Professor and Head of the Department and Dr. N. Pothirasan distributed the certificates to the participants. K. Gayathri of III year EEE delivered the vote of thanks. Totally 57 students participated in this programme.

AAA College of Engineering and Technology successfully organized the IBM Smart Skill Guided Learning Experience Training Programme in association with IBM and Edunet Foundation from 15th December 2025 to 18th December 2025 at the Visvesvaraya Seminar Hall, Cambridge Block. The programme was conducted with the objective of equipping students with industry-relevant knowledge and hands-on exposure to emerging technologies, thereby bridging the gap between academic learning and real-world industry expectations. The training programme was designed for III year students of AI & DS, Computer Science Engineering, Cyber Security, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, and Information Technology (Batch 2023–2027). The sessions focused on building a strong foundation in Artificial Intelligence, with special emphasis on modern concepts such as Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and LangChain, which are widely used in current AI-driven applications.

The programme was led by Mr. Vignesh Muthuvelan, M.Tech (IIT Patna), Master Trainer at Edunet Foundation, who served as the resource person. Through well-structured lectures, live demonstrations, and interactive discussions, the trainer introduced students to the fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence, its real-time applications, and its growing significance in various industries. The sessions provided students with practical insights into how AI solutions are developed and deployed in today’s technological landscape. Throughout the four-day programme, students actively participated in guided learning activities that enhanced their conceptual clarity and technical confidence. The training emphasized hands-on learning, problem-solving approaches, and exposure to industry-standard tools and frameworks. Students gained valuable knowledge on how Retrieval Augmented Generation improves AI model responses and how LangChain plays a crucial role in building intelligent, scalable AI applications.

### Department of Civil Engineering organized COMMUNICATION & SOFT SKILL TRAINING From 21-07-2025 to 25-07-2025

- August 2, 2025

Duration: 21.07.2025 to 25.07.2025 (5 Days) Time: 9.30 AM – 4.30 PM Venue: Civil Engineering Seminar Hall & II Year Classroom Participants: 36 Students (Civil Engineering II Year Students)

The Department of Civil Engineering organized a 5-day Communication & Soft Skill Training Program aimed at enhancing students’ communication abilities, self-confidence, and employability skills. The sessions were conducted by experts from i-Tech Academy, Tirunelveli – Mr. M. Chellapa (Senior Corporate Trainer & Financial Consultant), Mrs. C. Meena (Soft Skills Trainer & Communication Coach), and Mr. D. Shree Murugan (Financial Consultant & Soft Skills Trainer).

The program covered a range of topics:

- Day 1: Ice-breaker activities, motivation, and self-introduction.

- Day 2: Communication skills with emphasis on non-verbal aspects.

- Day 3: SWOT analysis and presentation skills.

- Day 4: Grooming, professional etiquette, and interpersonal skills.

- Day 5: Role play and speaking activities.

Objectives included improving verbal and non-verbal communication, building self-confidence, identifying personal strengths and weaknesses, enhancing presentation skills, and developing professional grooming habits.

Outcomes of the training demonstrated students’ improved confidence, communication proficiency, presentation delivery, interpersonal skills, and professionalism. The interactive sessions, motivational talks, and hands-on activities such as role plays and group discussions created an engaging learning atmosphere. Students reported significant gains in articulation, body language, and self-awareness.

Key Highlights:

- Ice-breaker sessions reduced stage fear.

- SWOT analysis enabled personal growth planning.

- Grooming and etiquette sessions enhanced professional appearance.

- Role-play provided real-life communication practice.

Overall, the program successfully achieved its objectives, equipping students with essential soft skills to face academic and professional challenges confidently.

### The Department of CSE (Cyber Security) organized its first Parent-Teachers Association meeting on 31-03-2025,

- April 2, 2025

The Department of CSE (Cyber Security) organized its first Parent-Teachers Association (PTA) meeting on March 31, 2025, at 10:00 AM in the Sir C. V. Raman Seminar Hall. The event was coordinated by Mrs. D. Grace Jothi, Class Advisor, and Mrs. S. Seethalakshmi, Mentor, along with student volunteers. Approximately 20 students’ parents attended the meeting. Dr. R. Raja Guru, Head of the Department, addressed the gathering, highlighting the progress made by the department. He emphasized that the core aim of the department is to provide students with a joyful learning environment by incorporating academic, co-curricular, and extracurricular activities to promote their development. He also spoke about the NPTEL exams, the Full Stack Development training program, and how these initiatives are beneficial to students. Dr. Raja Guru addressed the parents’ concerns and clarified their doubts regarding these programs. Additionally, he discussed the special remedial classes offered to students who scored below 60%, aimed at improving their academic performance. Mr. Sugumar, Manager of iTech Solution, gave a brief introduction to the Full Stack course and shared his personal experiences with the program. At the end of the meeting, parents raised queries about the Full Stack training, its opportunities, and requested more details about the NPTEL domain and the courses selected by students. These queries were addressed effectively by the Head of the Department. The class advisor and mentor also took the opportunity to address the parents before concluding the meeting.

page_title: THE DEPARTMENT OF MECHANICAL ENGINEERING ORGANIZES A” HANDS-ON TRAINING IN IOT” FROM 01-09-2025 TO 03-09-2025
text:
### THE DEPARTMENT OF MECHANICAL ENGINEERING ORGANIZES A” HANDS-ON TRAINING IN IOT” FROM 01-09-2025 TO 03-09-2025

- September 4, 2025

The Department of Mechanical Engineering of AAA College of Engineering and Technology, in association with the SAE INDIA Collegiate Club, organized a 3-day Hands-on Training in IoT from 01.09.2025 to 03.09.2025 at Sri Visvesvaraya Hall, AAA College of Engineering and Technology. The session was inaugurated in the presence of Dr. R. Selvabharathi (HOD/Mechanical Engineering). The resource person for the program was Mr. M. S. Kalyana Sundaram, M.E., (Ph.D), Assistant Professor / EEE & Coordinator – Centre of IIoT, AAACET, who shared his expertise in IoT applications. On Day 1, participants were introduced to the fundamentals of IoT, its architecture, and industrial applications. Brainstorming sessions enabled students to generate real-time problem-solving ideas using IoT. On Day 2, students gained hands-on experience with Arduino and Node MCU, exploring sensor interfacing, Arduino IDE coding, and wireless communication modules. They performed mini-experiments on temperature monitoring, motion detection, and basic home automation prototypes. On Day 3, the training focused on IoT cloud platforms such as Thing Speak and Blynk. Participant’s successfully uploaded data to the cloud, developed dashboards, and controlled appliances via mobile apps. Mini-projects including Smart Home Automation, IoT-based Weather Monitoring, and Gas Leakage Alert System were demonstrated. The 3-day program concluded with a valedictory session, certificate distribution, and feedback. The training enhanced students’ technical knowledge, practical skills, and confidence in IoT applications, preparing them for future research, projects, and industrial opportunities. As an outcome of this event, totally 16 IoT based mini projects were developed by the students. The program was effectively organized by Mr. A. Vignesh Moorthy Pandian and Mr. M. Nagendran.

page_title: Five-Day Rooftop Solar Supervisors Training Programme under Tata CSR Initiative from 31-03-2026 to 04-04-2026
text:
### Five-Day Rooftop Solar Supervisors Training Programme under Tata CSR Initiative from 31-03-2026 to 04-04-2026

- April 6, 2026

The Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering, AAA College of Engineering and Technology, Sivakasi successfully facilitated the participation of selected final-year EEE students in a five-day Rooftop Solar Supervisors Training Programme conducted under the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiative of Tata Power Company Ltd. The students were nominated through a structured and merit-based selection process. The programme was designed to strengthen their technical knowledge, practical skills, and overall understanding of renewable energy and sustainable technologies.

Organized as part of Tata’s CSR initiative and delivered through the Tata Power Skill Development Institute (TPSDI) , the training programme provided a comprehensive learning experience combining theoretical concepts with extensive hands-on practice. Students actively engaged in expert-led sessions, interactive discussions, and practical training modules focused on rooftop solar photovoltaic systems. The programme emphasized real-world applications, enabling participants to bridge the gap between academic learning and current industry practices in the energy sector.

During the training, students gained valuable exposure to solar panel installation techniques, system operation, maintenance practices, and safety standards followed in the industry. The hands-on training sessions conducted by industry experts enhanced their confidence and technical competency, making them better prepared for careers in the renewable energy sector. The programme also focused on improving employability skills by equipping students with job-oriented knowledge and practical experience.

In addition, the programme created awareness about the importance of clean and sustainable energy solutions in addressing current environmental challenges. It encouraged students to explore innovative approaches in the field of renewable energy and motivated them to contribute towards a greener and more sustainable future. The interactive nature of the sessions also helped in improving teamwork, communication skills, and problem-solving abilities among the participants.

Upon successful completion of the programme, students received a joint certification from the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) and Tata Power, adding significant value to their professional credentials. The training programme proved to be highly beneficial in enriching students technical expertise, promoting sustainable energy awareness, and preparing them to meet the evolving demands of the energy industry.

page_title: One day industrial visit to Sripathi Paper & Boards Private Limited, Thiruthangal, Sukkiravarapatti on 18-09-2026
text:
### One day industrial visit to Sripathi Paper & Boards Private Limited, Thiruthangal, Sukkiravarapatti on 18-09-2026

- September 19, 2026

As a part of the academic curriculum, the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering organized a one-day industrial visit for the students to Sripathi Paper & Boards Private Limited, Thiruthangal, Sukkiravarapatti. The visit was aimed at providing the students with practical exposure to the electrical and automation systems employed in a paper manufacturing industry, thereby bridging the gap between theoretical concepts and real-world industrial applications.

A team of 47 students, along with the faculty members Dr. M. Palpandian and Dr. P. Nirmal Kumar visited the industry and observed the various stages of the paper manufacturing process. The visit provided an opportunity for the students to understand the role of electrical power systems, industrial drives, motors, control systems, instrumentation, and automation in continuous manufacturing industries.

The students also interacted with the technical personnel and industry professionals, who explained the practical operation and maintenance of various electrical and control equipment. The visit enabled the students to relate their classroom learning in areas such as Electrical Machines, Power Systems, Power Electronics, Industrial Instrumentation, Control Systems, and Industrial Automation with their practical applications in the paper industry.

OBJECTIVES OF THE VISIT

The primary objectives of the industrial visit were:

- To understand the overall working process of a paper manufacturing industry.

- To gain practical exposure to the electrical systems used in continuous industrial processes.

- To observe the application of three-phase motors, industrial drives, control panels, and electrical protection systems.

- To understand the role of instrumentation, sensors, PLCs, and automation systems in industrial operations.

- To observe the electrical power distribution system adopted within the industry.

- To understand the importance of preventive maintenance and safety practices in industrial electrical systems.

- To interact with industry professionals and gain insights into real-time industrial practices.

- To bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical applications in electrical engineering.

INDUSTRIAL EXPOSURE

Sripathi Paper & Boards Private Limited, Thiruthangal, Sukkiravarapatti, provided the students with valuable exposure to the functioning of a paper manufacturing industry. During the visit, the students were introduced to the various stages involved in the manufacturing process and the supporting electrical and automation infrastructure.

The students observed the operation of different electrical machines, motors, drives, control panels, power distribution systems, instrumentation and automation equipment used in the plant. The technical personnel explained how electrical energy is utilized efficiently to operate various machines and production systems.

page_title: Guest Lecture on “Automotive Electronics overview and Career opportunities in electronics Industry“on 27.12.2022
text:
### Guest Lecture on “Automotive Electronics overview and Career opportunities in electronics Industry“on 27.12.2022

- ECE , Events college

- December 31, 2022

The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering in association with IETE students Chapter organized a one day Industrial Guest Lecture “ Automotive Electronics overview and Career opportunities in electronics Industry “on 27-12-2022 10.00 A.M. to 12.30 P.M. at Thomas Alva Edison seminar Hall. The Resource person was Mr. Mutharasu Beemarajan, Group leader, Electronic Base platform solutions, Vitesco technologies, Bangalore. The resource person is having more than 17 years of working experience, in the automotive electronics design for automobiles. The students of I year ECE & EEE students attended the Guest Lecture. Dr.T.Senthil Associate Professor /ECE welcomed the Principal, Resource person, and gathering. Mr.R.Saravanakumar Assistant Professor/ECE & IETE Coordinator ECE dept introduced the Chief Guest Mr.Mutharasu Beemarajan to the gathering. Dr.M.Sekar Principal honored the Chief Guest with memento shield and delivered special address in the meeting. Dr.T. Senthil Associate Professor /ECE proudly mentioned that Mr.Mutharasu Beemarajan is one of the distinguished alumni of 2004 passed out batch of AKCE krishnankoil.

The Resource person in his first session briefly described about the overview of the automotive electronics in the automobiles. He explained about the sensors used in measuring physical parameters of the typical IC engine and how the sensors output are electronically processed for achieving closed loop control system. The Resource person also briefed about the transmission electronics in the automobiles with CAN Controller Area Network) protocol. He also explained about the automotive electronic sub systems in a car like Engine Ignition, Fuel Injection, Anti-lock Brakes, Steering Control and Collision Avoidance Systems

The second session started, after a short 10 minutes tea break .The Resource Person Mr.Mutharasu Beemarajan in the second session briefed about the career opportunities for an electronics engineers in the electronics industries. He categorized the opportunities in the embedded system, Electronic design automation tools, VLSI design and sensor technologies .He also listed the opportunities in the various levels of electronic product development like design, fabrication, testing and calibration. He also explained about the knowledge domain needed for the job opportunities in the automotive electronics in terms of hardware and software design. The students and faculty members interacted during the question session with the resource person and the resource person also clarified their queries in both the session. Dr.T.Senthil proposed the Vote of Thanks. Online feedback forms are circulated and most of the students appreciated the technical content & Presentation of the Guest Lecture. The meeting ended with the National Anthem.

page_title: Two days Industrial Visit to KSEB Pallivasal Hydro Electric Project, Chithirapuram, Kerala from 21-03-2025 to 22-03-2025
text:
### Two days Industrial Visit to KSEB Pallivasal Hydro Electric Project, Chithirapuram, Kerala from 21-03-2025 to 22-03-2025

- April 4, 2025

As a part of the academic curriculum, the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering organized an industrial visit for the III-year students to the KSEB Pallivasal Hydro Electric Project, located at Chithirapuram, Kerala, on 21 st and 22 nd March 2025. 53 students along with the faculty members, Dr. S. Suganya, Associate Professor and Mr. R. Vinothkumar, Assistant Professor visited the power station. This visit aimed to provide the students with practical a exposure to hydroelectric power generation, bridging the gap between the theoretical concepts and the real-world applications. The visit also offered the students an opportunity to interact with the industry professionals and understand the practical aspects of power generation and distribution. Additionally, the visit included a jeep safari covering natural attractions such as the Sandal Forest, Aadi Veil Waterfalls, Strawberry Farm, Brammer View Point, Sugar Factory and Honey Rock followed by an exploration of the other scenic locations.

OBJECTIVES OF THE VISIT

The primary objectives of the industrial visit were:

- To understand the working principles of hydroelectric power plants.

- To gain insights into the various components of a hydroelectric power station.

- To observe the power generation, transmission, and distribution processes.

- To interact with engineers and professionals to understand real-time operational challenges.

- To enhance students’ knowledge on renewable energy resources and their significance.

The Pallivasal Hydro Electric Project is Kerala’s first hydroelectric project, commissioned in 1940. The plant is strategically located in the Western Ghats and harnesses water from the Muthirapuzha River, a tributary of the Periyar River. The project has an installed capacity of 37.5 MW and plays a vital role in the state’s power generation.

OUTCOME OF THE VISIT

The students gained practical exposure to hydroelectric power generation and its industrial applications. ### Department of Civil Engineering organized a Short Term Training Program (STTP) on Total Station from 04-08-2025 to 09-08-2025

- August 13, 2025

Date: 04-08-2025 – 09-08-2025

Time: 9.30 a.m. – 5.00 p.m.

Organized by: Department of Civil Engineering

Participants: 39 Students, 8 Teaching Staff

1. Introduction

The Department of Civil Engineering organized a Short Term Training Program (STTP) on Total Station from 4 th to 9 th August 2025. The program aimed to provide participants with theoretical knowledge and hands-on experience in modern surveying techniques using Total Station equipment.

2. Resource Person

Mr. S. Praneesh

Manager, RVS Land Surveyors

Brief Profile:

Mr. Praneesh holds an M.Sc. and B.Sc. in Geography and has experience as an Assistant Professor in the field. His research projects include “Estimation of Carbon Footprint by Individuals” and “Land Use/Land Cover Change Detection using Geospatial Techniques” . He is skilled in ArcGIS Desktop, SPSS, Microsoft Office, and has strong analytical and communication abilities.

3. Objectives

- Introduce Total Station equipment and its components.

- Train participants in instrument setup, calibration, and operation.

- Teach surveying techniques for distance, angle, and coordinate measurements.

- Demonstrate field applications such as topographic surveys, construction layout, and boundary marking.

- Guide data interpretation and processing using software like AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and Leica Geo Office.

4. Outcomes

By the end of the program, participants:

- Operated Total Station instruments in real-world scenarios.

- Understood modern surveying methods including traversing, levelling, contouring, and topographic surveys.

- Learned to record and export survey data to AutoCAD, GIS, and Excel for mapping and analysis.

- Applied Total Station techniques in construction layout, road alignment, boundary marking, and site planning.

5. Key Highlights

- Field survey techniques and coordinate systems.

- AutoCAD integration for survey data processing.

- Practical, hands-on training sessions in outdoor environments.

Outcome: The STTP successfully enhanced participants’ technical expertise in modern surveying practices, bridging the gap between academic knowledge and industry requirements.

text:
### Faculty Development Program on “Modern Survey Training using Total Station and Digital Global Positioning System and processing using Civil 3D” – 17/02/2022

- March 1, 2022

The Department of Civil Engineering of AAACET organized a Faculty Development Program on “Modern Survey Training using Total Station & Digital Global Positioning System and processing using Civil 3D” from 17/02/2022 to 21/02/2022. Dr.Thomas Gnanadurai, M.E., Ph.D., Duken Engineers, Thiruthangal, Sivakasi was the resource person for this event. The FDP aimed at imparting skills useful for conducting surveying works using Total Station & Digital Global Positioning System. The FDP was inaugurated on 17/02/2022 in the presence of the Principal Dr.M.Sekar, Civil Engineering faculty and students.

All the faculty members (10 Nos.) of Civil Engineering Department participated in the FDP and were trained to handle total station & DGPS and process the data using Civil 3D software. Total station and DGPS are modern surveying instruments which include functions of dumpy level, auto level and other conventional survey instruments. Also it is digital, automatic and provides high accurate data for solution of geodetic tasks. The use of AutoCAD Civil 3D software tools facilitates and accelerates the process of depicting engineering and land grade planning. Measurement with Total Station and depiction with AutoCAD Civil 3D have become one of the soft skill competencies to be possessed by Civil Engineering graduates. This five-day FDP helped the participants to get hands-on training on conducting survey using total station & DGPS and process the data using Civil 3D software. The participants attended all the sessions with enthusiasm and cleared their doubts during the interactive question and answer session. The FDP came to an end with the participants sharing their feedback.

page_title: Department of Civil Engineering is organised a Value Added Course “Smart Infrastructure: A Civil Engineering IoT & Robotics Bootcamp” from 12-08-2025 to 16-08-2025
text:
### Department of Civil Engineering is organised a Value Added Course “Smart Infrastructure: A Civil Engineering IoT & Robotics Bootcamp” from 12-08-2025 to 16-08-2025

- August 20, 2025

The Department of Civil Engineering organized a five-day Value Added Course titled “Smart Infrastructure: A Civil Engineering IoT & Robotics Bootcamp” from 12 th to 16 th August 2025 exclusively for final-year students. The program aimed to familiarize participants with emerging technologies such as Internet of Things (IoT) and Robotics in the context of civil infrastructure planning, construction, and maintenance.

Key Highlights of the Program:

- IoT in Infrastructure Monitoring: Basics of sensors, data logging, and cloud integration for structural health monitoring.

- Robotics in Civil Engineering: Applications in construction automation, inspection, and maintenance.

- Hands-on Demonstrations: Prototyping and testing IoT-enabled devices.

- Industry Case Studies: Insights into smart city projects and modern infrastructure solutions.

- Team Projects: Students worked in groups to design conceptual smart infrastructure models.

text:
### Three Days Faculty Development Programme on “Recent trends and advancements in semiconductor devices modelling through machine learning” on 23 – 25th January 2024

- January 27, 2024

The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering in association with IETE Students Chapter, AAACET organized, three days Faculty Development Programme on “Recent trends and advancements in semiconductor devices modelling through machine learning” on 23 -25,January 2024. External Participants from Anna University Guindy campus Chennai ,SRM Easwari Engg College Chennai ,E.G.S Pillai Engg College Nagapattinam ,Velammal Engg College Madurai ,PSR Engg College Kalasalingam University, Kamarajar Engg College VNR, Sri Vidhya Engg college VNR, registered for the FDP and attended .Internal Participants from various departments of AACET also participated .Mrs.K.Padmapriya AP/ECE welcomed all the participations for the three days FDP.In the Inaugural address Dr.M.Sekar Principal insisted the faculty members to attend this kind of FDP to update the latest technologies in their specific domain and disseminate the knowledge gained, among the student community. The external experts Dr.V.Sandeep Post –Doctoral Researcher KARE Krishnankoil, Dr.R.Ramesh Professor/ECE Sastra University, Thanjavur, Dr.N.B.Balamurugan Professor/ECE Thiyagarajar College of Engineering, Madurai and Mr.P.Muthukrishnan Hashan Medicare Bengaluru delivered the lecture in the FDP sessions.

The external experts explored the research areas and advancements in the VLSI device modelling, Phosphorene device modelling, GaN HEMT device modelling and electronic automation. The internal Experts Dr.T.Senthil HOD/ECE ,Dr.B.Padmanabhan ASP/ECE also handled sessions and delivered lecture in the Nano electronic device modelling. The Participations interacted with the experts regarding the problem identification for their research study and softwares needed for the device modelling. In the Valedictory function Dr.T.Senthil HOD/ECE outlined the Key takeaways from the experts lecture and asked the participants to attend the refresher FDP programme /Workshop to brush up the device modelling skills. Dr.M.Sekar Principal distributed the Participants certificate in the valedictory function. In the feedback session both external and internal participants expressed their appreciations for the FDP arrangements in the relevant design and semiconductor device modelling. Dr.B.Padmanaban ASP /ECE and Mrs.K.Padmapriya acted as Coordinators for the FDP. Dr.B.Padmanaban ASP/ECE delivered vote of thanks and the 3 day-long FDP was ended by concluding remarks of Dr.T.Senthil HOD/ECE, followed by National Anthem.
